description: f32 [3, 5]: transpose, then reduce dim [1], keepdim.
reference: torch.sum(x, dim, keepdim) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: x is fed as a transposed view: uploaded with its last two dims swapped, then transposed back. out is computed in f64 from the inputs and rounded once to the dtype under test; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator). f16/bf16 accumulate in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8).
